$description: MEKA OS design tokens (ADR-012). Semantic roles only; components never use raw values. W3C Design Tokens format.

accent.$description: Restrained warm brass; the only brand colour

barca.$description: Barça's lane in News and the ticker (a light garnet); news and the fixtures calendar's dot, never UI state

calendar1.$description: Calendar colours (Fold review 2026-10-08): a small dot per calendar in the Calendar tab, never UI state

type.$description: sizes in sp/pt, weight 100-900, tracking in em, lineHeight multiplier

motion.$description: Semantic motion. spring = (dampingRatio, stiffness); duration in ms. reduced = cross-fade only, no translation. expressiveDamping = the bouncier spring Appearance → Motion → Expressive uses (motion pass 2).

choreography.$description: Sequencing for motion, in ms unless noted. Reduced motion: no stagger or rise, count-ups jump to the value, shimmer holds still. expressive* = Appearance → Motion → Expressive (motion pass 2): a wider stagger, a bigger rise, entries growing from expressiveEntryScale, slower count-ups.

staggerMaxSteps.$description: Items past this index share the last delay so long lists never feel slow

riseDistance.$description: dp / pt an appearing item rises from

expressiveRiseDistance.$description: dp / pt an appearing item rises from in Expressive

expressiveEntryScale.$description: Scale an appearing item grows from in Expressive (unitless)

pressScale.$description: Scale anything tappable presses in to while held (unitless; Off: no scale, a brief dim)

hoverLift.$description: dp / pt a card lifts while the pointer is over it (Mac)

pullThresholdDistance.$description: dp / pt Today's content follows a pull before letting go syncs (pull to sync)

pullMaxDistance.$description: dp / pt the rubber-banded pull never goes past

syncSpinPeriod.$description: One turn of the brass sync ring while syncing; also the least time it shows, so a quick sync is still seen

sheetScrimOpacity.$description: How dark the screen behind a pane dims as it springs up (unitless; black)

checkDraw.$description: Completing a task: the ring sweeps round, fills, then the check strokes in, before the row leaves (Off: drawn at once)

dayRingMark.$description: First open of the day: the brass MEKA mark (the Day ring's track) draws itself round before the arcs come in

dayRingArc.$description: Each arc of the Day ring grows from its start, one after another (the stagger step apart) as the mark closes

dayRingNeedle.$description: The Day ring's now needle sweeps from midnight (the top) to now

dayRingQuick.$description: Later opens the same day: mark, arcs, needle and count-up all play within this (Off: drawn at once)

greetingLetter.$description: First open of the day: the greeting's letters fade in one after another, this far apart (Off: shown at once)

greetingLetterFade.$description: Each letter of the greeting fades (and rises a little) in over this

emptyBreathPeriod.$description: One slow breath (in and out) of the brass ring beside an empty state such as "You're clear." (Off: still)

swipeArmDistance.$description: dp / pt a swiped row travels before letting go does its action; the colour behind deepens and the icon grows on the way, then pops

swipeIconPopScale.$description: Scale a swipe action's icon pops to once the swipe is armed (unitless; Off: no pop)
